verdict.rationale: Vanta documents its own questionnaire automation. It claims to automate questionnaires "from start to finish" and leaves users only to "review, approve, and submit," and it has API endpoints for managing questionnaire responses. That implies some intake and return of questionnaires. However, nothing in the evidence names SIG, CAIQ, portals or spreadsheets, or says completed questionnaires go back in the customer's original format. missing for 10: documented import of SIG/CAIQ/spreadsheet files, portal-based questionnaire support, export in the customer's original format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent

citations.quote: Streamline security reviews with agentic workflows that automate questionnaires from start to finish. Vanta takes care of the heavy lifting—so all you need to do is review, approve, and submit.
Vanta combs through your knowledge base of security documentation and previous questionnaires to generate responses for new questionnaires.
Four new endpoints manage the responses on a Customer Trust questionnaire.
